description: The Arkestra GitHub App's events live in the IDE, through the webhook relay, and the workspace's GitHub Project kept in sync both ways: CI, pull requests, reviews, issues, project fields and dependencies.
relayUrl: The webhook relay's address on the edge server, for example `https://edge.example.com/arkestra`. The client token is stored with **Arkestra: Connect to the GitHub relay**.
appSlug: The Arkestra GitHub App's slug (from its page on GitHub), for the install link.
install: Install the Arkestra GitHub App on a repository…
project: The GitHub Project this workspace follows, as `owner/number` (for example `tenarkhq/3`) or the project's URL. Changes on GitHub show up within seconds; changes made in Arkestra are written to GitHub at once.
signIn: Sign in to GitHub for the project sync
setProject: Follow a GitHub Project in this workspace…
openBoard: Add a board (Board, Table, Plan, Graph) on the Boards page…
openBoards: Boards: every GitHub Project you added
cardFields: The project fields the board's cards show, by name (for example `Line`, `Executor`, `Review`). Empty: the first four fields besides Status.
laneField: The project field the Plan view's release lanes come from (for example `Line`). Empty: a field named Line, Release, Milestone or Version.
weightField: The number field that weights a task in the lanes' progress (for example `Estimate`). Empty: a field named Estimate, Size or Points; without one, every task weighs the same.
remote.start: Remote Control: turn on (threads on your phone)
remote.copyLink: Remote Control: copy the pairing link
remote.toggleAll: Remote Control: every thread / only chosen threads
